source_text: Capite nobis vulpes pusillas exterminantes vineas; et vineae nostrae florebunt. Persona mutata: sponsus ad sodales loquitur. Vulpes in anima: contrariae potestates et cogitationes pravae florem virtutum exterminantes. Angeli sancti capiant eas dum pusillae sunt, ante consensum et effectum peccati.
pass_a_gloss: Catch for-us foxes little destroying vineyards; and vineyards our will-flower. Person changed: bridegroom to companions speaks. Foxes in soul: contrary powers and thoughts crooked flower of-virtues destroying. Angels holy may-catch them while little they-are, before consent and effect of-sin.
pass_b_english: [[Catch us the little foxes that spoil the vineyards; and our vineyards will flower >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:15]]. The person changes: the Bridegroom speaks to his companions. Foxes in the soul are contrary powers and crooked thoughts destroying the flower of the virtues. Holy angels are to catch them while they are little, before consent and the deed of sin.
